items.title: Finding Community and Belonging at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon NA 2026
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>"Everyone here is learning."

When contributor Anuja Kafle attended her first session, she noticed something that changed her perspective on the entire open source ecosystem. People who were just starting their careers and students in their first years of college were sitting alongside engineers with more than twenty years of industry experience.

Even more impactful was realizing that everyone was asking similar questions. When Anuja asked for guidance, a mentor reminded her that nobody has everything figured out because open source technology is constantly advancing. That conversation turned what could have been an intimidating experience into a genuine feeling of belonging.

The cloud native ecosystem thrives because of this culture of shared learning and open mentorship. Whether you are exploring containerization for the first time or orchestrating complex systems in production, your questions and contributions matter.

Join us in person to experience this community firsthand at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America 2026. Meet maintainers, discover emerging tools, and collaborate with engineers who are building the next generation of cloud native infrastructure.

Register now: https://bit.ly/4z2FJO6

#CNCF #CloudNative #KubeCon #OpenSource</article>

items.title: Meet Parth Arora - Speaker at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>Discover how Rook brings Ceph storage to Kubernetes.

At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America, Parth Arora of IBM will join a panel introducing the CNCF Graduated Rook project and its approach to cloud native storage.

Explore how Rook configures Ceph to provide block, shared file system and object storage for production Kubernetes data.

Join us November 9-12 in Salt Lake City.

Explore the Session: https://bit.ly/4izaC7u

Register: https://bit.ly/3BDI5XL</article>

items.title: Meet William Morgan - Speaker at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>The tokens are free. The GPU time, not so much.

At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America, William Morgan of Buoyant will explain how to build a practical, scalable and multi-tenant LLM token factory on Kubernetes using open source technology.

Learn about model selection, inference servers, authorization, rate limiting, quality of service, concurrency, and serving capable open weight models reliably at scale.

Join us November 9-12 in Salt Lake City.

Explore the Session: https://bit.ly/4dNo2u2

Register: https://bit.ly/3BDI5XL</article>

items.title: Meet Shachar Tal - Speaker at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>How can Kubernetes nodes operate with zero egress, no NAT Gateway, and no route to the API server?

At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America, Shachar Tal of Palo Alto Networks will share how his team adapted Konnectivity to use cloud object storage as a secure rendezvous medium.

Explore the architecture behind interactive kubectl exec and kubectl logs sessions, reliable message delivery, and sub-second latency for worker nodes running inside air-gapped VPCs.

Explore the session: https://bit.ly/4zIQ6a7

Join us November 9-12 in Salt Lake City.

Register: https://bit.ly/3BDI5XL</article>

items.title: Meet Antonio Jimenez Martinez - Speaker at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]

<article>What if network paths could appear inside the same observability workflow as application traces?

At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America, Antonio Jimenez Martinez of Cisco ThousandEyes will show how traceroute-style measurements can be represented as OpenTelemetry traces.

Explore span hierarchies, timing metadata, incomplete paths, and strategies for correlating network-path traces with application traces from end to end.

Explore the session: https://bit.ly/4hWgl77

Join us November 9-12 in Salt Lake City.

Register: https://bit.ly/3BDI5XL</article>

items.title: Meet Chris Maher - Speaker at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]

<article>Can Apple Silicon become a production GPU node for LLM inference on Kubernetes?

At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America, Chris Maher of Ashley Furniture Industries will share how his team extended Kubernetes to schedule inference across heterogeneous GPU hardware using pluggable runtime backends.

Learn about model lifecycle management, multi-GPU sharding, memory validation, Prometheus metrics, and the operational tradeoffs between NVIDIA CUDA and Apple Silicon Metal.

Explore the session: https://bit.ly/4jZDJSu

Join us November 9-12 in Salt Lake City.

items.title: Why Community is Key at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>CNCF Ambassador Orlin Vasilev shares why the greatest value of KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America is connecting face-to-face with project maintainers and building real community relationships.

For platform engineers and open source contributors, gathering in person provides a unique opportunity to meet core project maintainers, exchange insights, and understand the future direction of essential cloud native tools straight from the source.

Register for KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America:

items.title: Meet Kevin Klues - Speaker at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>Memory-coherent hardware gives applications a unified address space across CPU and GPU memory. It also challenges assumptions built into Kubernetes.

At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America, Kevin Klues of NVIDIA will examine the failures uncovered by this new memory model, the path to Coherent Driver-based Memory Management and the patches still needed for reliable Kubernetes operation.

Explore the session: https://bit.ly/4yywyog

Join us November 9-12 in Salt Lake City.

Register: https://bit.ly/3BDI5XL</article>
